items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...could it be Dick Holler? ... [INTERVIEWEE] He was the guy. Like I said, he went on the right. ... double shot him. My baby's love.

ctx.x: No. You got to trust you?
No. Let me see. No, no, no, no, no. Oh, could it be Dick Holler? There's a group. Dick Holler. Dick Holler and the Rockets. Yeah. Yeah. That was it. Dick Holler.
He was the guy. Like I said, he went on the right. You know. Like I said, double shot him. My baby's love.
